verification.fixes: All 35 findings fixed record by record. verification.residualRisk: The sample error rate implies other full-research records may carry similar errors, especially builder amenity lists and status for coming-soon communities, and HOA details for small associations. Treat description and amenity fields for new-construction communities as needing a quick human check before publishing.
verification.secondPass: A second independent check covered 30 records changed on 2026-09-23 (new research, Palmer Ranch counts, builder updates, new map points): 559 fields, 524 confirmed, 25 unreadable by automated fetch, 7 wrong and 3 unsupported.
